senses: any instrument for keeping the mouth closed
grc:noun:φιμός.html:
φιμ-ός, ὁ, heterocl. pl.
φιμά (Anyte):—any instrument for keeping the mouth closed:
muzzle, for dogs, calves, etc., φιμὸν περιτιθέναι τινί, cf. APl. c., .
gag: hence, silencing by a spell, (Curium, iii A. D.).
nose-band of a horse's bridle, fitted with pipes, φ. δὲ συρίζουσι βάρβαρον βρόμον; πώλους . . φιμοῖσιν αὐλωτοῖσιν ἐστομωμένας; ἐμβαλῶ φ. εἰς τὴν ῥῖνά σου.
a kind of cup, used as a dice-box, , , cf. , .
tightening, constriction by means of ropes, Apollod .
=φίμωσις , φ. τοὺς ἐν αἰδοίοις χαλᾷ, cf. ap. ; imperforation of the anus, ap. . (Connected with σφίγγω, σφιγμός by .)

senses: shut up as with a muzzle
to be put to silence, be silent
